statement: Between 2026-10-27 and 2026-11-30, the United States and Iran conclude an agreement covering the Strait of Hormuz that both the White House and the Iranian foreign ministry publicly confirm as concluded.
resolution: True if, between 2026-10-27 and 2026-11-30, both the White House and the Iranian foreign ministry confirm a concluded US-Iran agreement covering the Strait of Hormuz; statements that a deal is close or under negotiation do not count.
failure_condition: No US-Iran agreement covering the Strait of Hormuz is confirmed as concluded by both governments within the window.

statement: Between 2026-10-27 and 2026-11-16, Saudi authorities (Ministry of Defense or the Saudi-led coalition) publicly confirm at least one new Houthi missile or drone launched toward Saudi territory, whether intercepted or impacting.
resolution: True if a Saudi Ministry of Defense or coalition statement, carried by Reuters or AP, confirms at least one Houthi missile or drone launched toward Saudi territory with launch date between 2026-10-27 and 2026-11-16.
failure_condition: No Houthi missile or drone launch toward Saudi territory dated within the window is confirmed by Saudi authorities.

statement: The front-month NYMEX WTI crude futures contract settles below 85.00 USD per barrel on 2026-12-15. Reference: 100.93 on the packet date 2026-10-26.
resolution: True if the CME Group official settlement price for the nearest-expiry NYMEX WTI crude oil futures contract on 2026-12-15 is below 85.00 USD per barrel; reference level 100.93 on 2026-10-26.
failure_condition: The 2026-12-15 settlement price of the front-month WTI contract is 85.00 USD per barrel or higher.

statement: Anthropic common stock has its first day of trading on Nasdaq or the NYSE on a date between 2026-10-27 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: True if the exchange listing record and an SEC EDGAR 424B4 prospectus (or equivalent direct-listing filing) show Anthropic shares first traded on Nasdaq or NYSE on a date between 2026-10-27 and 2026-12-18.
failure_condition: Anthropic shares have not had a first trading day on Nasdaq or NYSE within the window, including if the offering is priced but not traded, postponed, or withdrawn.

statement: CISA adds at least one of the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 or CVE-2026-109619, to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog JSON feed contains an entry for CVE-2026-109618 or CVE-2026-109619 whose dateAdded field is between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-20 inclusive.
failure_condition: Neither CVE-2026-109618 nor CVE-2026-109619 appears in the CISA KEV catalog with a dateAdded value inside the window.

statement: In the 2026-11-03 US House elections, Democratic candidates win at least 218 of 435 seats, as called by the Associated Press by 2026-12-04.
resolution: True if, by 2026-12-04, Associated Press race calls show Democratic candidates winning at least 218 US House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election; uncalled races count as not won.
failure_condition: AP race calls as of 2026-12-04 show Democratic candidates with fewer than 218 House seats won.

statement: BMA consultant doctors in England are on strike on 2026-11-25, the first day of the two-day action announced for 2026-11-25 to 2026-11-27.
resolution: True if BMA consultant doctors in England are on strike on 2026-11-25, confirmed by both a BMA statement and NHS England; action suspended, cancelled or postponed before that date resolves false.
failure_condition: The consultants strike does not take place on 2026-11-25 because it is suspended, cancelled, or postponed.

statement: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) of Brazil holds the diplomacao ceremony formally conferring the presidential diploma on Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva on a date between 2026-12-01 and 2026-12-19.
resolution: True if the TSE official website or Diario da Justica Eletronico records the diplomacao of Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva as president-elect on a date between 2026-12-01 and 2026-12-19 inclusive.
failure_condition: The TSE does not confer the presidential diploma on Lula within the window, whether because the ceremony is held outside it, postponed, or the result is not proclaimed.

statement: The USGS earthquake catalog records at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater with a USGS place name containing Bonin Islands and origin time between 2026-10-27 00:00 UTC and 2026-11-30 23:59 UTC.
resolution: True if the USGS ComCat catalog lists an event with magnitude 6.0 or greater, place field containing Bonin Islands, and origin time between 2026-10-27 00:00 UTC and 2026-11-30 23:59 UTC.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater with a Bonin Islands place name occurs within the window per the USGS catalog.

statement: A jury at Southwark Crown Court returns a verdict on at least one count in the trial of Russell Brand on a date between 2026-10-27 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: True if a jury verdict, guilty or not guilty, on at least one count against Russell Brand is delivered at Southwark Crown Court between 2026-10-27 and 2026-12-18, as reported by Reuters and the BBC.
failure_condition: No jury verdict on any count against Russell Brand is delivered within the window, including if the jury is discharged without a verdict or the trial runs past 2026-12-18.
